split_rule: Temporal partition: train uses all slices from M5-M7 (6046 shots); validation uses all M8 samples (559 shots / 6206 slices); test uses all M9 samples (507 shots / 17498 slices). Training fractions are nested shot subsets (1 < 5 < 10 < 25 < 50 < 100 percent; seeds 20260825/20260827). Each training slice records its fraction membership. The archive covers scratch and fine-tuned models at all five experimental fractions; the original 2026-09-02 archive covered only 5% and 1%.

phase_composition.train: All training slices from the shot subset selected for each data fraction

notes: Training run manifests use subset_run_real_{f}pct and include all validation rows; only training-phase rows are used as training samples.
